problem_title: Sharp constants for the 3 by 3 permanental Koteljanskii ratio

evidence.text:
For every real strictly totally positive 3 by 3 matrix, the source permanental Koteljanskii ratio lies strictly between 2/3 and 9/8, and both constants are optimal. Positive scalings reduce the proof to two polynomial certificates; strictly totally positive families approach the bounds. The result answers the explicit optimal-constant question accompanying Skandera–Soskin Proposition 11.See full solutionHide full solutionFor every real strictly totally positive 3 by 3 matrix, the source permanental Koteljanskii ratio lies strictly between 2/3 and 9/8, and both constants are optimal.
